judgment.notes: M001 is applied with base R, algebra K via the constructed ρ, module M_R and the N004 basis (b e_i). All module/ring conditions are available and the flip supplies the required tensor orientation. M002 is applied over K to the transported basis β with finite index I; N001 gives card(I)=n>0 and BG009 verifies the strong rank condition. No E applications occur.

S001 constructs the fraction map with nonzero denominators and gives both directions of A; S002 gives both directions of B and checks quotient-lift and scalar-lift independence using p=0. The routine characteristic, residue-field and tensor universal-property steps are positively checked in BG001–BG008. S003 uses M001 and the explicit flip/A transports, and its finite-coordinate reduction argument proves the quotient basis (BG010); M002 then gives the dimension. S004 transports the actual integer matrices, with preservation supplied by N002; factorial units stay nonzero under the unital map to K, so division is legitimate. The commutator and generator compatibility checks are expanded in BG011. S005 tensors the supplied matrix-unit identity, whose binomial scalar remains a unit. All indices in that formula lie in [0,λ], so x,y-invariance implies invariance under its factors and their composite. The λ=0 and r=0 cases are included; no division by a zero scalar is used.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
